resources.string: German speech stays on-device and is translated locally to English with Bergamot.
Gemini streams microphone audio to Google for German transcription. English translation still runs locally with Bergamot.

Add an API key before starting Gemini captions.
The key is encrypted with Android Keystore and kept across app restarts. It is not backed up or logged.

German and English captions will appear here.
Primeline finalizes German after a short speech pause; Bergamot then adds the English translation.
Nemotron 3.5 updates German while you speak; Bergamot follows with the latest English partial and final translation.
Canary finalizes German after a short speech pause; Bergamot then adds the English translation.
Gemini 3.5 streams German interim and final transcripts over the network; Bergamot translates the newest German captions locally.
